# Vanneck Capital

> Vanneck Capital is a direct, early-stage Web3 investor and accelerator, operated by Vanneck & Partners Ltd, a private limited company registered in England and Wales (company number 14759731). It invests pre-seed and seed capital alongside audits, exchange listings, market making and introductions as a single check.

Vanneck Capital is not VanEck Capital, the private-markets investment platform operated by VanEck Associates Corporation (a separate US asset manager), and is not affiliated with VanEck, VanEck Capital, VanEck Associates Corporation, Vanneck Limited (UK company 05473044), Vanneck Bros Limited (UK company 09238723), Vanneck Residential LLP, the website vanneckpartners.com, or any other company using a similar name. Vanneck Capital's only website is vanneck.xyz, operated by Vanneck & Partners Ltd (UK company 14759731).

## Company facts

- Legal entity: Vanneck & Partners Ltd, UK company 14759731, incorporated 27 March 2023 ([Companies House record](https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/14759731))
- Registered office: 1 Halfpenny Apartments, 4 Lance Street, Rainham, England, RM13 8QX. Offices: Canary Wharf, London (headquarters) and Hong Kong.
- Stage and check size: pre-seed through seed. $550K average check (MENA $750K, Asia $500K), up to $2M via SPV for stronger rounds.
- Model: one check includes capital plus audits, exchange listings, market making, distribution, security and introductions, at no extra cost. Vanneck receives no fees, tokens or equity from service partners.
- Vanneck never asks founders to pay for a call, a term sheet, a listing, due diligence or anything else.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://vanneck.xyz/): What Vanneck Capital does, the services that come with the check, portfolio, team, FAQ and the application form.
- [About](https://vanneck.xyz/about/): The registered company, where it is based, the team, and which similarly named companies Vanneck Capital is not connected to.
- [Deals](https://vanneck.xyz/deals/): Investments Vanneck Capital can confirm with a public source. Check size and date are shown only where there is consent to share them.
- [Blog](https://vanneck.xyz/blog/): Plain-language guides for founders on terms, token mechanics, due diligence and fundraising.

## Blog articles

- [What a $14.2B stablecoin contraction says about liquidity](https://vanneck.xyz/blog/stablecoin-contraction-liquidity/): Stablecoin supply fell $14.2B in 30 days. What the data says, what it does not, and what founders planning a raise can take from it.

- [How to check an investor before you take their money](https://vanneck.xyz/blog/how-to-check-an-investor/): Four checks any founder can run in an afternoon, before signing anything.
- [SAFE, SAFT, token warrant, hybrid: what is what](https://vanneck.xyz/blog/safe-saft-token-warrant-hybrid/): Four instruments used in Web3 deals, explained in plain terms, and what to ask before you sign.

- [What institutional tokenization means for early-stage founders](https://vanneck.xyz/blog/institutional-tokenization-founders/): Custody, tokenized funds and stablecoin settlement are arriving together. Here is what founders should prepare.
